newsitem.title: FINLAND: SUPPORT FOR FINNISH CENTRE PARTY DOWN IN APR - POLL.
newsitem.headline: SUPPORT FOR FINNISH CENTRE PARTY DOWN IN APR - POLL.

text.p: The opposition Centre Party's
recent rise in polls turned into a fall in April while support
for a small opposition group, the liberal conservative Young
Finns party, surged, Finnish radio news reported on Friday.
Support for the biggest party in parliament and government,
Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen's social democrats, remained on
its recent downward sloping trend.
The second biggest government group, Finance Minister Sauli
Niinisto's Conservative Party, saw its rating fall below 20
percent for the first time since December.
The regular monthly poll for the radio news by research
institute Taloustutkimus Oy was conducted between April 1 and
May 7 among 1,903 Finns of voting age.
(Previous surveys also by Taloustutkimus, figs in pct):
April March Feb Election '96 Election '95
Leftist Alliance 8.6 7.7 9.1 10.4 11.2
Young Finns 6.2 3.5 3.4 1.3 2.8
Swedish Party 4.5 4.4 4.1 5.5 5.1
Christian League 3.4 2.6 3.0 3.2 3.0
Perussuomalaiset 1.0 1.1 1.0 0.9 1.3
NOTE -- Election '96 is local government election held in
October last year and Election '95 is parliament election held
in March 1995. The next general election is due in March 1999.
NOTE -- Finnish radio said the margin of error in the
Talostutkimus polls was on average +/- two percentage points.
